about: 가지급금정산서(원본 회계 I › FastEntry › 가지급금정산서 E010505, 2026-10-12 실측) — 빈 채로 [저장(F8)] → '계정코드를 입력 바랍니다.', [정산자 검색]에 사원 이름 Enter → 정산대상자명 · 계정 811 복리후생비가 찬다, 금액 9,000 · 적요 저장 → 빈 화면. 분개 차) 복리후생비 9,000 / 대) 가지급금 9,000(적요 같음), 회계거래조회 [거래처명] = 정산자. 시험 전표는 API 로 지운다. node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/advance-settlement.json

shots.name: 빈 저장 거절 → 정산자 줄 저장 → 분개
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const es = await (await fetch('/api/employees', { headers: H })).json(); window.__emp = es.find((e) => es.filter((x) => (x.code + ' ' + x.name).includes(e.name)).length === 1); const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; const c = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="사원검색"]'); set(c, window.__emp.name); c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); return true })()
expect:(() => { const tr = document.querySelector('table.ec-grid-input tbody tr'); return tr.innerText.includes(window.__emp.name) && tr.innerText.includes('복리후생비') })()

js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="1줄 금액"]'), '9000'); set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="1줄 적요명"]'), 'QA회계1-flow 가지급정산'); return true })()

expect:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = await (await fetch('/api/vouchers?type=ADVANCE_SETTLEMENT', { headers: H })).json(); const v = d.rows.find((r) => r.lines.some((l) => l.description === 'QA회계1-flow 가지급정산')); if (!v) return false; const j = await (await fetch('/api/journals/' + v.journalEntryId, { headers: H })).json(); const ok = v.payeeName === window.__emp.name && v.lines[0].employeeId === window.__emp.id && j.lines.some((l) => l.accountCode === '811' && Number(l.debit) === 9000) && j.lines.some((l) => l.accountCode === '134' && Number(l.credit) === 9000 && l.description === 'QA회계1-flow 가지급정산'); await fetch('/api/vouchers/' + v.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return ok })()
